name: Voodoo Dues
summary: "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay needs to balance his books by collecting outstanding debts from three old associates. Though rumors claim the men were cursed and bewitched into wandering ancient jungle ruins, MacKinley expects their prized possessions retrieved regardless of their grim fate.

sections.title: Unpaid Accounts
sections.body: Following your earlier collection efforts for "Sea Wolf" MacKinley, the pirate still holds an active ledger of unsettled debts. Three particular debtors—Maury "Club Foot" Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky "Ten Thumbs"—have let their accounts sit delinquent for months. MacKinley initially assumed the trio merely skipped out of Booty Bay to avoid paying, but he later heard they met a stranger and darker fate deep in the jungle.

sections.title: Bewitched in the Ruins
sections.body: Whispers say the three debtors were bewitched and cursed, leaving them to wander the ancient stonework northeast of Booty Bay at the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal. Unconcerned with their misfortune, MacKinley directs you to venture into the ruins, track down each man, and seize their notable valuables: Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, Chucky's Huge Ring, and Maury's Clubbed Foot.

faq.q: Who is asking to collect these debts?
faq.answer: "Sea Wolf" MacKinley makes this request from his post in Booty Bay. He is working his way down a list of debtors who owe him money and refuses to let their debts slip away.
The debtors are Maury "Club Foot" Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky "Ten Thumbs". Their payments have been outstanding for several months.

faq.q: Where can the three debtors be found?
faq.answer: They wander the ancient stone structures northeast of Booty Bay, specifically within the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal.

faq.q: What happened to the three men?
faq.answer: According to word that reached MacKinley, the three were bewitched and cursed, and now roam the jungle ruins instead of returning to port.

faq.q: What specific items must be recovered?
faq.answer: MacKinley requires three specific valuables: Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, Chucky's Huge Ring, and Maury's Clubbed Foot.

faq.q: What came before this task in the chain?
faq.answer: This follows the earlier jobs of Scaring Shaky and Return to MacKinley, as you assist the pirate with his collection list.
